info.title: LPG Agency Management Platform
info.description:
Multi-tenant SaaS platform for LPG distributors.

All error responses follow RFC 7807 Problem Details, extended with a stable `error_code`. Success responses return the resource directly — there is no success envelope.

get.description: Returns 200 whenever the process is running. Checks no external dependency by design — a failure here means the container should be restarted.
Reports whether every dependency required to serve traffic is reachable. Returns 503 when any dependency is down, so the instance is removed from rotation without being restarted.

post.description:
`booked -> confirmed`. Resolves and snapshots unit prices; runs the
BR-04/BR-19 stub policy checks (see `infrastructure/order/policies.py`).

`confirmed -> assigned`. Reserves stock on the vehicle atomically with
the Order's own transition (BR-09/D-08 backorder split) and attaches a
`delivery.route_stop` (Phase 12) — see `AssignOrderUseCase`'s docstring
for how the underlying `Route` is found or planned.
`assigned -> ready_for_dispatch` ("vehicle loaded").

`ready_for_dispatch -> out_for_delivery` ("driver departs"). Issues
the delivery OTP to the customer's phone post-commit.

`failed_delivery -> ready_for_dispatch`. Also resets the paired
`RouteStop` back to `pending` so the retry can reach `delivered` (see
`RescheduleOrderUseCase`'s docstring).
Pre-upload a delivery photo/signature blob before `POST .../deliver`.

`out_for_delivery -> delivered`. Idempotency-Key required (offline-
sync retries). Missing POD fields are a 422 (see `ProofOfDeliverySubmission`);
present-but-invalid ones (blank ref, out-of-range GPS) are a 400
`IncompletePodError`; wrong/expired OTP is a 409.
`out_for_delivery -> failed_delivery` (D-12).

200 (pre-dispatch, immediately `cancelled`) or 202 (post-dispatch,
status unchanged, pending Manager approval — D-19).
Approve a pending post-dispatch cancellation. Live-checked (D-19).

<=50 order ids cancel synchronously (each its own transaction — see
`get_cancel_order_use_case_factory`'s docstring for why one shared
transaction can't process more than the first order); more enqueues
`bulk_cancel_orders`.

`delivered -> closed` — manual interim action pending Phase 13's
automatic invoice-settlement trigger.

post.summary: Assign an unassigned order onto this route
post.description:
The Dispatch Board's own multi-order grouping action — the Order
Queue/Detail single-order "Assign" flow instead calls
`POST /orders/{id}/assign`, which finds-or-creates a route and
delegates to this same use case internally (see `AssignOrderUseCase`'s
docstring in `application/order/use_cases.py`).

post.summary: Load the vehicle and mark the route loaded
post.description: `planned -> loaded` (BR-12): atomic warehouse -> vehicle transfer.

post.summary: Close out a route once its vehicle has been reconciled
post.description:
`completed -> reconciled` (BR-14) — `409 ROUTE_RECONCILIATION_PENDING`

first).

CustomerResponse.title: CustomerResponse
CustomerResponse.description:
The general customer profile — deliberately excludes `kyc_documents`.

KYC documents are more sensitive PII than the rest of this profile
(`docs/data/17-api-security.md` §10) and are gated by their own
`kyc:read` permission, distinct from `customers:read` — see
`GET /customers/{id}/kyc`. `kyc_status` stays here: it is a coarse
account-status field on `customer.customer` itself, not a document.

LivenessResponse.title: LivenessResponse
LivenessResponse.description: Process is up. Nothing external is consulted.

PrincipalResponse.title: PrincipalResponse
PrincipalResponse.description:
Returned by `GET /auth/me` — feeds the Dashboard's permission-driven
UI (`08-security-architecture.md` §3: the same permission list drives
what renders client-side, while the API remains the actual enforcement
point regardless).

ProofOfDeliverySubmission.title: ProofOfDeliverySubmission
ProofOfDeliverySubmission.description:
All five fields are non-optional — a missing one is a 422 before the
request ever reaches `DeliverOrderUseCase`.

RefreshRequest.title: RefreshRequest
RefreshRequest.description:
`refresh_token` is optional in the body — the Dashboard's browser
client relies on the `HttpOnly` cookie instead
(`api/v1/routers/auth.py`'s module docstring). Mobile clients, which
can't rely on a cookie, supply it here.
